description: Defines the UUID class for Bluetooth, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and string conversion of UUIDs.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth UUID with methods for validation, comparison, serialization, and string conversion.

methods.name: UUID()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing UUID to invalid state.

methods.name: UUID(const uint32_t uuid)
methods.description: Constructs UUID from a 32-bit integer, setting short or full UUID based on value.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const uint8_t uuid[16])
methods.description: Constructs UUID from a 16-byte array, detecting if it contains the base UUID.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Constructs UUID from a string representation.

methods.name: UUID(const UUID& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: ~UUID()
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: operator=(const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Assignment operator.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if UUID is valid.

methods.name: Short()
methods.description: Returns the short 16-bit UUID if available.

methods.name: Full()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the full UUID bytes.

methods.name: operator==(const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Equality comparison with another UUID.

methods.name: operator!=(const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Inequality comparison.

methods.name: operator==(const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Equality comparison with a short UUID.

methods.name: operator!=(const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Inequality comparison with a short UUID.

methods.name: operator<(const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Less-than comparison for UUID ordering.

methods.name: HasShort()
methods.description: Checks if UUID is a short UUID.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns length indicator of UUID (2 or 16).

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns pointer to UUID data bytes.

methods.name: ToString(const bool full = false)
methods.description: Converts UUID to string, full or short format.

methods.name: FromString(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Parses UUID from string representation.
